name: multiturn-benchmark-data
description: A collection of multi-turn conversational examples intended to benchmark dialogue models on multi-turn coherence, instruction-following, and response quality. Used to evaluate model behavior across consecutive turns rather than single-turn prompts. Often combined with human evaluation or conversation-level automatic metrics for assessment.
reputation: Relatively low community adoption; hosted on Hugging Face and primarily used for niche multi-turn dialogue evaluations.
